Name: Multiple Construction Orders
Author: MoonSlime
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3qxSqCb.png[/img]
I am currently playing on a server with 12 other people and we are bottle-necked by Robin. We want to keep close to vanilla feeling as possible, so instead of going with instant building, we reached this compromised. We still have to wait for Robin and have downtime in-between construction orders, but we can load up on as many construction orders as possible in a single day. 

While building, you will see multiple construction workers helping you build!

[/i]Download, unzip, and place the MultipleConstructionOrders folder into the Stardew Valley Mod folder.
If installed on an existing file, the new professions should be immediately available.
Should be compatible with most other mods.  Please share incompatible mods on Nexus.
Not compatible with Android.
